elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Teleglobe USA Inc. remains committed to bear Capital Costs and O&M Costs for the then-current 12-month period.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Payment remains based on allocated Capital Costs and O&M Costs under Schedule B, not solely on usage or ordered Services.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The added language expressly limits Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to the then-current twelve-month period.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Teleglobe USA Inc. may reduce its commitment and Investment Share on thirty days' written notice to the Management Committee.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Any shortfall resulting from the reduction must be settled through a true-up of costs actually incurred and allocated, expressly excluding penalties, forfeiture, and reclamation of capacity.
